packageRules.description: A closed PR skips the version its title names. The default major title names only the major (`to v5`), so closing it would skip every later v5 release.
Major updates only, since group:allNonMajor holds every other update. Both packages pin a workerd version; one bumped without the other runs two runtimes.
Every update type, because each wrangler release can pin a new workerd. The script runs once per matching package in the PR, and a second run changes nothing.
update-dekit-canary.yml updates the canary (ADR 0009). npm tags each new canary latest, so Renovate would open a second PR for the same version.
@den-ai/muxa is published to npm, so its dependencies keep ranges: an exact version would force every consumer to install that exact copy.

customManagers.description: semantic-release runs through bunx or npx, outside package.json, so every line that names its version is bumped here.
